after_run: Add manifest.json ledger.charged_dollar_upper_bound (the conservative figure) and estimated_actual_dollars_from_reported_tokens to the project ledger's carried total; the probe's own ledger (probe-ledger.sqlite3) is in no product campaign ledger or dashboard total.
approved_by: Claude (Opus 5.5) as PM, decision authority delegated by the project owner (Shree); owner present in the session and informed

pre_registered_outcomes.P1: dev-5 first-turn hypotheses that blame citations, labels or evidence ids. A person marks every delivered dev-5 row Y or N in review-blinded.csv without seeing the checker or the arm. Confirmed = a checker v2 claim match AND the person's Y. Pass if CONTROL confirmed >= 20 of 40 AND GUIDE confirmed plus GUIDE rows the person marked Y without a checker match (these are counted against the GUIDE bar) <= 4 of 40; CONTROL confirmed < 20 of 40 is UNINFORMATIVE (the premise failed).
pre_registered_outcomes.P2: dev-5 first-attempt validity in GUIDE not lower than CONTROL by more than 5 of 40; over-600 count not higher by more than 5 of 40.
pre_registered_outcomes.P3: counts and a one-sided Fisher test, no pass bar: valid non-null requests; C3 and C5 naming by the written rubric (person-scored); dev-6 naming C4 rather than o3.
pre_registered_outcomes.P4: repair turns returning a valid answer with a hypothesis of at most 600 characters: pass if at least 9 of 10 on each setup with the Rule 1 message; today's message measured as the baseline. For the decision rule, 'worse' means the Rule 1 message's valid-within-600 total over both setups (of 20) is lower than today's total.
pre_registered_outcomes.decision_rule: Rule 1 ships after its offline tests unless P4 shows the new message is worse than today's. Rule 2 ships only if P1 and P2 pass. If P1 fails, the next design trims the label text from diagnosis requests only. If P1 passes but P3 shows declines unchanged, the Mechanic's veto persists and the gate question goes to the owner separately.
pre_registered_outcomes.repeats: The frozen temperature is 0. Scoring reports, per request key, the delivered answers, the distinct raw answers and the distinct hypotheses; the declaration's sampling.repeats_reading says how repeated answers are read.

sampling.repeats_reading: Temperature is the product's frozen 0, so repeats measure the provider's run-to-run variation at the setting the product actually uses (v2d and v2e received identical fixed text and answered differently). Each delivered answer counts as one sample of what the product would receive. Distinct raw answers and distinct hypotheses per request key are reported beside every rate; where a request key yields a single distinct hypothesis in an arm, that key is read as one observation, not ten, and the write-up says so.

human_review_note: The P1 and P3 person-marked columns will be marked by Claude (the PM), not by a human, blind to arm and checker output (review-blinded.csv), before opening review-key.json; this is disclosed in the write-up. The owner may re-mark the same file.
